paper_id.description: Stable id for this paper. Format: YYYY (no set) or YYYY-S<n> (with set).

paper.description: Human-readable name as rendered by the source.

set.description: Set number when the year has multiple sets; null when the year is a single paper.

source_url.description: Canonical URL (page 1) at the source site.

source_id.description: The site's internal quizId, for debugging.

scraped_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the paper was scraped.

id.description: Stable id, format '<paper_id>-Q<number>'. The join key for results and the reviewer.

source_id.description: Site's internal question id, for debugging.

source_paper_id.description: Topic mocks only. The paper this question came from; images are cached under this id.

source_number.description: Topic mocks only. The question's number in its original paper ('number' is its position in the mock).

negative_marks.description: Penalty for a wrong answer. 0 for MSQ and NAT; marks/3 for MCQ.

question.description:
Question body with [latex]...[/latex] wrappers kept raw, inline
and kept.

code.description: Reserved. Null unless the scraper confidently extracted a code block to display monospaced.

images.description: Image URLs referenced from the question or its options (absolute URLs). Downloads happen in a later stage.

options.description: Object keyed by A/B/C/D for MCQ and MSQ (plus E on some pre-1995 papers). Null for NAT.

correct.description: Array of letters for MCQ (exactly 1) and MSQ (1..5). Null for NAT.

nat_range.description: [low, high] accepted range for NAT (inclusive). Null for MCQ/MSQ.

accepted.description: Optional. Extra answers the official key also accepts: letter arrays for MCQ/MSQ, [low, high] ranges for NAT.

marks_to_all.description: Optional. True when the official key awarded full marks to every candidate (question dropped).

key_source.description: Optional. Where a corrected key came from, when it differs from the site.

topic.description: Canonical topic from schema/topics.json (official GATE CSE syllabus subjects).

subtopic.description: Free-form subtopic from the source tag.

explanation.description: Explanation/solution. Captured from the source when available; may later be rewritten by the reviewer.

explanation_source.description: Where the current explanation came from. 'none' until populated.
